content_html:
Technology development services: building with the right stack

Our technology development services cover the frameworks and platforms modern websites and apps run on: React, Next.js, Angular and Vue on the front end; Node.js, NestJS, Python and Laravel on the back end; and Shopify, WooCommerce and Webflow for stores and marketing sites. We pick the technology that fits your goals, team and budget, not the trend.

Frontend frameworks

  • React development. Component-based interfaces for websites and web apps, with the largest ecosystem and talent pool.
  • Next.js development. Fast, SEO-friendly sites with server rendering and static generation. Our default for public business websites.
  • Angular development. Structured, TypeScript-first apps for large enterprise teams.
  • Vue.js development. Lightweight, easy-to-maintain apps for small and mid-size projects.
  • Bootstrap and Tailwind. Responsive layouts, either fast with ready components or fully custom with utility classes.

Compare them in our frontend development guide.

Backend technologies

  • Node.js development. Fast APIs and real-time features in JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • NestJS development. Structured, maintainable Node.js apps for larger teams.
  • Python web development. Django, Flask and FastAPI for data-heavy and AI-driven platforms.
  • Laravel development. Secure, fast-to-build PHP business applications.

See how they compare in our backend development guide.

Ecommerce and website platforms

  • Shopify development. Store setup, themes, apps, integrations and migrations.
  • WooCommerce development. Flexible WordPress stores with custom features.
  • Webflow development. Design-led marketing sites your team can edit visually.
  • Headless commerce. A custom storefront on top of a commerce engine, for large catalogues and top speed.

Read more in ecommerce development and WordPress and CMS development.

Modern rendering and app formats

  • Static site generation (SSG). Pre-built pages served from a CDN for speed and security.
  • Server-side rendering (SSR). Fresh, personalised pages that still rank well.
  • Progressive web apps (PWAs). Installable, app-like websites that work offline.
  • Voice-ready websites. Structured data and clear answers for voice search and assistants.

Learn more in web architecture and cloud development.

How to choose the right technology stack

  1. Start from the job the site must do: inform, sell, or run a service.
  2. Check SEO and speed needs: public pages need server or static rendering.
  3. Consider your team: who will maintain it after launch?
  4. Plan for growth, security and budget, both upfront and ongoing.

Common, proven stacks include Next.js with Node.js, the MERN stack, and Laravel or Django with a React or Vue front end. See full stack and databases for details.

What to expect from a technology partner

How to choose technology development services

First, start with the business problem, not the technology. For example, you may need faster order processing, fewer manual tasks or better customer data. Next, ask partners which tools they would use and why. In addition, check that they can connect new systems with what you already run, such as your website, CMS, CRM or ecommerce store. Then plan in phases, so you see value early and reduce risk. Also agree how support will work after launch. As a result, technology development services solve real problems instead of adding new ones. Finally, measure the outcome, such as hours saved or errors reduced, so you know the investment paid off.

Look for production experience in your chosen stack, TypeScript fluency where relevant, testing and code reviews, good Core Web Vitals on live work, clear documentation and agreed support after launch. Explore our website development services or talk to us about the right stack for your project.

Frequently asked questions

What is React website development?

Building websites and apps with React's reusable components, often with Next.js for SEO and speed.

Is React good for SEO?

Yes, when pages are rendered on the server or at build time, for example with Next.js. Client-only React needs extra care.

How do I choose a development company for a specific technology?

Look for production experience in that stack, good Core Web Vitals on live work, testing practices, documentation and clear support terms.

Shopify, WooCommerce or Webflow?

Shopify for easy stores, WooCommerce for flexible WordPress stores, and Webflow for design-led marketing sites.

How long does a React or Next.js website take to build?

A marketing site usually takes four to eight weeks; complex web apps take three months or more.
